case.summary: The user states that their company has not paid their money/salary.
case.user_goal: Get their pending salary or dues from the company
follow_up_questions: Aapka kitna paisa ya kitne mahine ka salary baaki hai?
Aap kaunse state me rehte hain?
Kya aapke paas offer letter ya koi written proof hai?

notes: Not enough numbers to calculate. Tell me the amounts involved.
Interest on delayed money may be claimable; the rate is for a lawyer/court to decide, so we don't add it here.

assessment.where_user_stand: Aapka employer aapka unpaid salary ya dues dene ke liye legally bound hai, aur Code on Wages ke tahat salary time par milni chahiye [KB:cow_s17]. Agar employer payment nahi karta, toh aap Labour Department ke paas 3 saal ke andar claim file kar sakte hain [KB:cow_s45]. Yeh bhi dhyan rakhein ki non-payment ke case mein employer ko prove karna hota hai ki unhone payment kar diya hai [KB:src_cow_2019_59]. Lekin aapke paas abhi offer letter, payslips ya bank statements jaise proofs ki kami hai, jo ki case ko strong banane ke liye zaroori honge.

options.title: Written Demand Message bhejiye
options.what_to_do: Apne employer ya HR ko WhatsApp ya email par ek written message bhejiye jismein apne pending salary aur amount ka clear zikr karein.

options.title: Labour Commissioner Office mein Complaint
options.what_to_do: Agar employer response na de, toh local Labour Department ya authority ke paas unpaid wages ke liye application file karein.

proof_tips: Employer ya HR ko WhatsApp par message karke likhiye ki aapka kitna mahine ka salary baaki hai, taaki unka reply written proof ban sake.
Apne bank account statements check karein jisse pata chale ki pichli salary kab aayi thi.
what_i_dont_know: Aapka kitna paisa ya kitne mahine ka salary baaki hai.
Aap kaunse state ya city mein kaam kar rahe hain.
Kya aapke paas employment ka koi written proof jaise offer letter ya ID card hai.
assessment.needs_lawyer_reason: Abhi koi court case ya criminal angle nahi hai, aur aap khud ek written demand ya labour department mein complaint file kar sakte hain. Lawyer ki zaroorat tab padegi jab case labour authority mein aage badhega.
assessment.reply: Aapka company ki taraf se salary rokna galat hai aur Code on Wages ke mutabik aapko apne dues milne chahiye [KB:cow_s17]. Aap 3 saal ke andar Labour Department mein iska claim file kar sakte hain [KB:cow_s45]. Kyunki abhi hamare paas aapke offers, payslips ya exact amount ki details nahi hain, pehla kadam yeh hoga ki aap HR ya employer ko WhatsApp ya email par ek written reminder bhejein taki baat record par aaye. Aapka kitna paisa ya kitne mahine ka salary baaki hai?
